concerns.text: The `LongitudinalRecord` entity in `data-model.md` includes fields `attachment_anxiety_score`, `attachment_avoidance_score`, `age`, `gender`, and `lag_usage_frequency` (see table), but the `dataset.schema.yaml` contract defines `records` without these fields. This mismatch means the pipeline will produce records that fail schema validation.

The `records` object in `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` omits several fields present in the data model (`attachment_anxiety_score`, `attachment_avoidance_score`, `age`, `gender`, `lag_usage_frequency`). The contract must be updated to reflect the full set of fields used by the plan.
